mentions.name: Mac Video Manager
mentions.description: A Mac-based video manager that automatically transcribes, translates and summarises videos, used to manage a growing collection of training course videos, webinars and meeting recordings. RAG search is being added to make it easier to query the video content.
mentions.problem: The builder processes information best through reading and needed a way to manage a growing collection of training course videos, webinars and meeting recordings.
mentions.source_excerpt: A Mac-based video manager that automatically transcribes, translates and summarises videos. I process information best through reading, so I built it to manage my growing collection of training course videos, webinars and meeting recordings. Currently working on adding RAG search to make it easier to query content.
